prerequisite: C4 exact-head engine evidence and required foliage profiling observations completed before runtime implementation begins.
purpose: Prepare a low-cost Shire/Bag End environment presentation pass after foliage cost is bounded.

performance_contract.target: 720p Low-Medium / 30 FPS floor / i7 Gen6 / 8GB RAM / ~2GB VRAM
performance_contract.lighting: Prefer baked/static or stationary lighting where practical; keep dynamic shadowed lights bounded.
performance_contract.fog: Use restrained UE4.27-compatible fog; no expensive cinematic volumetric dependence on the target profile.
performance_contract.water: Use bounded simple water materials/reflection strategy; avoid universal high-cost translucency/reflection features.
performance_contract.textures: 1K/2K default; hero 4K only after measured VRAM approval.

implementation_boundaries: No story outcome or canon beat changes.
Lighting/sky/fog state is driven by chapter/world-state, not autonomous presentation logic.
No per-actor Tick for ambient presentation where a shared subsystem/material parameter can own the state.
Heavy environment assets remain soft referenced and asynchronously loaded.
Do not increase foliage density while tuning atmosphere.
acceptance: Human PIE review is still required for mood/readability.
Target-device performance evidence is still required before PERFORMANCE-ACCEPTED.
evidence_boundary: Preparation only. No runtime, visual or performance acceptance claim.
